slice: Isolate native add-zero with the same constant-list optimizations in both variants

decision.reason: Matching the two planning optimizations preserves local execution gains but does not eliminate all costs. Single-item planning instructions increase about 1.14-1.17%, while its time intervals include zero. Utf8 and Decimal execution controls remain slower with unchanged plans and effectively unchanged instruction counts.
decision.planning_interpretation: Add-zero does not uniformly add planning instructions. Short and nullable cases retire about 1.1-1.2% fewer; single items retire more. Long-list elapsed regressions also occur in unchanged-plan controls, so they cannot all be assigned to extra expression work.
decision.next_reviewable_slice: Evaluate the Float64 identity shortcut and canonical-list elision on the runtime without add-zero against the historical accepted runtime. Keep their adoption separate from add-zero.

decision.noise_caveat: Seven of eight same-binary intervals include zero. The frozen add-zero Decimal control is +0.3724% with interval [0.0265%,0.9230%]; retain this drift, do not claim a noise-free experiment.
decision.long_list_variability: The first four-pair DOUBLE zero-long series was +14.18% with a wide interval spanning zero. Eight- and sixteen-pair repeats were -1.73% and -0.9875%. No observations were discarded. Nonzero DOUBLE execution has no resolved time difference in the sixteen-pair check; its instruction difference shrinks from about +0.34% to +0.024%.
decision.layout_evidence: The generic IN bitmap body remains 628 bytes and 160 normalized instructions. Its start modulo 64 is 48 in matched no-add-zero and 0 in frozen add-zero. This is consistent with the prior controlled layout finding, not proof that every residual cost is explained or a portable fix.

scope: Build the no-add-zero baseline by subtracting only the input eligibility/addition branch from the frozen candidate. Keep scalar identity, constant-list elision, dependency patches and the benchmark identical. Reuse the add-zero executables without rebuilding.

callers.purpose: IN subquery normalization with a dynamic output column

retained_in_both_variants: NaN, dynamic and FLOAT widening fallback
CASE zip, Boolean cast and integer-bit floating hash dependency patches
source_analysis.only_runtime_difference: The matched baseline deletes zero-only column eligibility and native addition, and sends the input through the existing conversion closure.
source_analysis.test_change: The same 960 evaluations and 3937920 independently expected values remain. Zero-containing cases now require input normalization; constant-list assertions remain.
source_analysis.measurement_direction: Percent changes always mean frozen add-zero relative to matched no-add-zero; negative latency is faster.
source_analysis.plan_validation: Compare all final physical plans to their corresponding frozen historical no-add/add variant. Require each changed unresolved plan to replace only column + typed positive zero with spark_comparison_float(column). Direct computed inputs retain both plans.

correctness.note: Frozen Spark references and unchanged add-zero binaries/tests are reused. The rebuilt no-add-zero planner and lifecycle tests are rerun. Expected plan changes are verified separately from values/types/status. This adds no Spark-reference coverage.

performance.percent_direction: add-zero relative to matched no-add-zero; negative means faster
performance.method: Builds, tests and source inspection finish before timing. Runs are sequential on CPU 2 with 1048576 preloaded rows, batches of 8192, two warmups and nine samples. Adjacent fresh-process pairs use balanced shuffled order and identical launch paths. Counters are phase-gated and fully scheduled. Time changes compare medians of process medians; intervals resample whole pairs and describe the paired median.

diagnostics.labels: Disassembly uses build order: before = frozen add-zero, after = matched no-add-zero. Timing uses the reverse order, as recorded above.

limitations: One machine/core and batch size. No Delta I/O or concurrency timing. Bootstrap intervals are conditional on this series and do not adjust for comparison selection.
The matched source comparison still relinks the executable. Unchanged-plan controls detect performance differences that cannot be attributed to new execution instructions.
Add-zero still allocates a values buffer and can prevent inverse-cast filtering after an aliased projection. Those mechanisms are unchanged by the two shared planning optimizations.
The 331 raw Spark-reference differences and other historical performance costs remain outside this slice.

import json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent
cases=[];expected={}
for source,values in [('DECIMAL(18,4)',[0,1.25,-1.25,None]),('BIGINT',[0,1,-1,None])]:
    table=','.join(f'({i},CAST({value if value is not None else "NULL"} AS {source}))' for i,value in enumerate(values))
    for kind,cast in [('subquery_cast','CAST(v AS DOUBLE)'),('subquery_try','TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE)'),('cte_cast','CAST(v AS DOUBLE)')]:
        inner=f'SELECT id,{cast} AS x FROM (VALUES {table}) t(id,v)'
        prefix=f'WITH q AS ({inner}) ' if kind=='cte_cast' else ''
        relation='q' if kind=='cte_cast' else f'({inner}) q'
        for negated in [False,True]:
            predicate=f'x {"NOT IN" if negated else "IN"} (CAST(0 AS DOUBLE),CAST(1.25 AS DOUBLE),CAST(2 AS DOUBLE))'
            answers=[None if v is None else int((v in [0,1.25,2]) != negated) for v in values]
            for filtered in [False,True]:
                case_id=f'{source[:3].lower()}_{kind}_{negated}_{filtered}'
                sql=prefix+(f'SELECT id FROM {relation} WHERE {predicate} ORDER BY id' if filtered else f'SELECT id,CAST({predicate} AS INT) AS r FROM {relation} ORDER BY id')
                cases.append({'id':case_id,'sql':sql,'batch_size':2})
                expected[case_id]=([[str(i)] for i,a in enumerate(answers) if a==1] if filtered else [[str(i),str(a) if a is not None else None] for i,a in enumerate(answers)])
file=p/'alias-controls.jsonl';file.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(c)+'\n' for c in cases))
captures={}
for variant in ['before','after']:
    output=p/f'{variant}-alias-controls.json'
    subprocess.run([str(p/f'{variant}-probe'),str(file),str(output),'--physical-plans'],capture_output=True,check=True)
    captures[variant]=json.loads(output.read_text())
    assert len(captures[variant]['results'])==48
    for row in captures[variant]['results']:
        assert row['actual']['status']=='ok',row['id']
        assert row['actual']['rows']==expected[row['id'].rsplit('_',1)[0]],row['id']
changes=[]
for a,b in zip(captures['before']['results'],captures['after']['results'],strict=True):
    assert a['id']==b['id']
    fields=sorted(k for k in a['actual'].keys()|b['actual'].keys() if a['actual'].get(k)!=b['actual'].get(k))
    assert set(fields)<={'logical_plan','physical_plan'},(a['id'],fields)
    if fields:changes.append({'id':a['id'],'fields':fields,'before':a['actual'],'after':b['actual']})
report={'observations':48,'independent_expected_rows':expected,'cases':cases,'changes':changes,'captures':captures}
(p/'alias-control-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print('48 aliased computed-input observations checked; changed plans:',len(changes),flush=True)

import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).parent
cases, expected = [], {}
for source, values in [('DECIMAL(18,4)', [0, 1.25, -1.25, None]), ('BIGINT', [0, 1, -1, None])]:
    table = ','.join(f'({i},CAST({value if value is not None else "NULL"} AS {source}))' for i, value in enumerate(values))
    for kind, operand in [('cast', 'CAST(v AS DOUBLE)'), ('try', 'TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE)'),
                          ('case', 'CASE WHEN id=0 THEN CAST(0 AS DOUBLE) ELSE CAST(v AS DOUBLE) END')]:
        for negated in [False, True]:
            predicate = f'{operand} {"NOT IN" if negated else "IN"} (CAST(0 AS DOUBLE),CAST(1.25 AS DOUBLE),CAST(2 AS DOUBLE))'
            answers = [None if value is None else int((value in [0, 1.25, 2]) != negated) for value in values]
            for filtered in [False, True]:
                case_id = f'{source[:3].lower()}_{kind}_{negated}_{filtered}'
                sql = (f'SELECT id FROM (VALUES {table}) t(id,v) WHERE {predicate} ORDER BY id' if filtered else
                       f'SELECT id,CAST({predicate} AS INT) AS r FROM (VALUES {table}) t(id,v) ORDER BY id')
                cases.append({'id': case_id, 'sql': sql, 'batch_size': 2})
                expected[case_id] = ([[str(i)] for i, answer in enumerate(answers) if answer == 1] if filtered else
                                     [[str(i), str(answer) if answer is not None else None] for i, answer in enumerate(answers)])
file = p / 'cast-controls.jsonl'
file.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(case) + '\n' for case in cases))
captures = {}
for variant in ['before', 'after']:
    output = p / f'{variant}-cast-controls.json'
    subprocess.run([str(p / f'{variant}-probe'), str(file), str(output), '--physical-plans'], check=True, capture_output=True)
    captures[variant] = json.loads(output.read_text())
    assert len(captures[variant]['results']) == 48
    for row in captures[variant]['results']:
        assert row['actual']['status'] == 'ok', row['id']
        assert row['actual']['rows'] == expected[row['id'].rsplit('_', 1)[0]], row['id']
assert captures['before'] == captures['after'], 'computed-input plans must retain the existing normalizer path'
(p / 'cast-control-check.json').write_text(json.dumps({'observations': 48, 'independent_expected_rows': expected,
                                                      'all_capture_fields_identical': True, 'capture': captures['after']}, indent=2) + '\n')
print('48 computed-input observations preserve values, types, status and both plans.')

import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent
prior=p.parent/'float-in-canonical-list-25f56d4'
load=lambda f:json.loads(f.read_text())
audit=load(p/'exact-replay-audit.json')
cases=[]; expected={}
for name,rows in audit.items():
    ids={r['id'].rsplit('_',1)[0] for r in rows if 'error' in r['changed_fields']}
    if not ids:continue
    assert all(r['changed_fields']==['error'] for r in rows if 'error' in r['changed_fields'])
    old=load(prior/f'after-{name}.json')
    cases.extend(c for c in old['cases'] if c['id'] in ids)
    expected.update({r['id']:r['actual'] for r in old['results'] if r['id'].rsplit('_',1)[0] in ids})
file=p/'diagnostic-cases.jsonl'
file.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(c)+'\n' for c in cases))
runs=[]
for index in range(3):
    for v in ['before','after']:
        out=p/f'diagnostic-{v}-{index}.json'
        command=[str(p/f'{v}-probe'),str(file),str(out),'--physical-plans']
        subprocess.run(command,check=True,capture_output=True)
        observations=[]
        for r in load(out)['results']:
            old=expected[r['id']];new=r['actual']
            assert {k:v for k,v in old.items() if k!='error'} == {k:v for k,v in new.items() if k!='error'},r['id']
            observations.append({'id':r['id'],'status':new['status'],'error':new.get('error'),'physical_plan_sha256':hashlib.sha256(new.get('physical_plan','').encode()).hexdigest()})
        runs.append({'variant':v,'index':index,'command':command,'capture_sha256':hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'observations':observations})
(p/'diagnostic-reruns.json').write_text(json.dumps(runs,indent=2)+'\n')
print(len(cases),'parallel-error queries rerun three times per variant, both ANSI modes; all fields except first-error text identical.')

import hashlib
import json
import mmap
import re
import struct
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).parent
q = p
prior = p.parent / 'float-in-zero-case-f354c70'
selected = [json.loads((prior / 'code-comparison.json').read_text())['functions'][0]['name']]
records = [{'name': name} for name in selected]
sha = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
for variant in ['before', 'after']:
    binary = q / f'{variant}-bench'
    symbols = subprocess.check_output(['nm', '-SC', '--defined-only', str(binary)], text=True)
    (p / f'{variant}-symbols.txt').write_text(symbols)
    rows = [row for line in symbols.splitlines() if len(row := line.split(maxsplit=3)) == 4]
    names = {int(row[0], 16): row[3] for row in rows if int(row[0], 16) != 0}
    with binary.open('rb') as file, mmap.mmap(file.fileno(), 0, access=mmap.ACCESS_READ) as elf:
        assert elf[:6] == b'\x7fELF\x02\x01'
        section_offset = struct.unpack_from('<Q', elf, 0x28)[0]
        section_size, section_count = struct.unpack_from('<HH', elf, 0x3a)
        relocations = {}
        for i in range(section_count):
            section = struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQIIQQ', elf, section_offset + i * section_size)
            if section[1] != 4:  # SHT_RELA
                continue
            for at in range(section[4], section[4] + section[5], section[9]):
                address, info, addend = struct.unpack_from('<QQq', elf, at)
                if info & 0xffffffff == 8:  # R_X86_64_RELATIVE
                    relocations[address] = addend
        for n, record in enumerate(records):
            found = [row for row in rows if row[3] == record['name']]
            assert len(found) == 1
            start, size = [int(x, 16) for x in found[0][:2]]
            assembly = subprocess.check_output(['objdump', '-d', '-C', '--no-show-raw-insn', '-Mintel',
                                               f'--start-address={start}', f'--stop-address={start + size}', str(binary)], text=True)
            normalized, resolved = [], {}
            for line in assembly.splitlines():
                instruction = re.match(r'^\s*([0-9a-f]+):\s+(.*)$', line)
                if not instruction:
                    continue
                op = instruction[2]
                slot = re.search(r'#\s+([0-9a-f]+) <_DYNAMIC[^>]*>', op)
                if slot:
                    target = relocations[int(slot[1], 16)]
                    name = names[target]
                    resolved[slot[1]] = {'target': hex(target), 'name': name}
                    op = op[:slot.start()] + '# <' + name + '>'
                op = re.sub(r'\[rip[+-]0x[0-9a-f]+\]', '[rip+relocation]', op)
                op = re.sub(r'\b[0-9a-f]+ <', '<', op)
                normalized.append(f'{int(instruction[1], 16) - start:04x} {op}')
            normalized = '\n'.join(normalized) + '\n'
            record[variant] = {'start': hex(start), 'size': size, 'alignment_mod64': start % 64,
                               'normalized_sha256': sha(normalized.encode()),
                               'instruction_count': len(normalized.splitlines()), 'resolved_slots': resolved,
                               'normalized': normalized, 'assembly': assembly}
            (p / f'code-{n}-{variant}.txt').write_text(assembly)
            (p / f'normalized-{n}-{variant}.txt').write_text(normalized)
for record in records:
    record['normalized_equal'] = record['before']['normalized'] == record['after']['normalized']
(p / 'code-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'method': 'Compare instruction offsets and operations, remove link addresses from named calls and RIP references, and resolve anonymous GOT slots using ELF R_X86_64_RELATIVE relocations and symbol names. This checks selected function bodies, not the entire executable or runtime data placement.',
    'functions': records,
}, indent=2) + '\n')
for record in records:
    print(record['before']['instruction_count'], 'instructions; equal:', record['normalized_equal'], record['name'][:140])

references, counts = {}, collections.Counter()

def read(file):
    references[str(file)] = sha(file)
    return load(file)

def check(before, after, old_add, old_no_add, benchmark=False):
    assert before['id'] == after['id'] == old_add['id'] == old_no_add['id']
    a, b, x, y = [r if benchmark else r['actual'] for r in [before, after, old_add, old_no_add]]
    assert a.get('physical_plan') == x.get('physical_plan'), before['id']
    assert b.get('physical_plan') == y.get('physical_plan'), before['id']

    counts['physical_plans_checked'] += a.get('physical_plan') is not None
    counts['physical_plans_changed'] += a.get('physical_plan') != b.get('physical_plan')
    if a.get('logical_plan') != b.get('logical_plan'):
        # At resolution the candidate only changes a column, never an arbitrary
        # expression. Constants and every other plan fragment must stay intact.
        expected, n = re.subn(
            r'((?:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*\.)?#[0-9]+) \+ Float(?:32|64)\(0\)',
            r'spark_comparison_float(\1)', a['logical_plan'])
        assert n > 0 and expected == b['logical_plan'], before['id']
        counts['exact_logical_replacements'] += 1

    before = read(frozen / f'after-{name}.json')['results']
    after = read(p / f'after-{name}.json')['results']
    old_add = read(zero / f'after-{name}.json')['results']
    old_no_add = read(historical / f'after-{name}.json')['results']
    for rows in zip(before, after, old_add, old_no_add, strict=True):
        check(*rows)

    old_add, old_no_add = [read(zero / f'{v}-{name}.json')['results'] for v in ['after', 'before']]
    for rows in zip(before, after, old_add, old_no_add, strict=True):
        check(*rows, benchmark=name in ['check', 'subquery-check'])

import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).parent
sha = lambda f: hashlib.sha256(Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
load = lambda f: json.loads(Path(f).read_text())
sources = load(p / 'initial-sources.json')
executables = load(p / 'initial-executables.json')
for key, record in sources.items():
    file = Path(record['path'])
    expected = [p / f'before-source-{key}']
    if key == 'common.rs': expected.append(p / 'candidate-common.rs')
    allowed = {sha(f) for f in expected if f.exists()}
    if record['existed']:
        assert sha(p / f'initial-{key}') == record['sha256'], key
        allowed.add(record['sha256'])
    if file.exists(): assert sha(file) in allowed, key
    else: assert not record['existed'], key
for key, record in executables.items():
    allowed = {record['sha256']} | {sha(p / f'{v}-{key}') for v in ['before', 'after'] if (p / f'{v}-{key}').exists()}
    assert sha(record['path']) in allowed, key
    assert sha(p / f'initial-target-{key}') == record['sha256'], key
restored = {'sources': {}, 'executables': {}}
for key, record in sources.items():
    file = Path(record['path'])
    if record['existed']:
        shutil.copyfile(p / f'initial-{key}', file)
        shutil.copymode(p / f'initial-{key}', file)
        stamp = time.time_ns()
        os.utime(file, ns=(stamp, stamp))
        assert sha(file) == record['sha256']
        restored['sources'][key] = {'sha256': sha(file), 'fresh_mtime': True}
    else:
        file.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        restored['sources'][key] = {'absent': True}
for key, record in executables.items():
    file = Path(record['path'])
    file.unlink()
    shutil.copyfile(p / f'initial-target-{key}', file)
    file.chmod(0o755)
    assert sha(file) == record['sha256']
    restored['executables'][key] = {'sha256': sha(file)}
(p / 'restoration.json').write_text(json.dumps(restored, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Restored shared sources, lockfiles and executable slots.', flush=True)

    summary[name] = json.loads((p / name / 'summary.json').read_text())
    (p / f'{prefix}-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')
    row = summary[name]
    print(comparison, case, phase, round(row['latency_change_pct'], 3), row['paired_median_bootstrap_95_percentile_interval'], flush=True)
